_comment: E4 CUDA gate,30Oct2026; command-only boot; pinned Ember archive includes all10 synthetic families and fail-closed receipt checker. Root watchdog owns launch and budget. No training corpus or mtstudio build required.

jobs.name: e4_device
cmd: set -eu; out="$1"; mkdir -p "$out"; for f in ember.tgz small.tgz COMMITS e4_vm.sh; do cp "/content/chat/upload/$f" "/content/$f"; done; rc=0; bash /content/e4_vm.sh || rc=$?; cp /content/vm.log "$out/vm.log"; if [ -s /content/out.zip ]; then cp /content/out.zip "$out/out.zip"; fi; if [ -s /content/out/gate_summary.json ]; then cp /content/out/gate_summary.json "$out/gate_summary.json"; fi; exit "$rc"
